why: 满足全部条件的改动，应当通过。
request: 给聊天记录导出工具加一个字数统计，统计前去掉 think 块、引用行和“助手：”前缀，空回复计 0。

task.title: 统计回复字数
task.goal: 导出时写入去掉 think 块、引用行和前缀之后的字数
acceptance: 当导出一条模型回复时，系统应当写入 word_count 字段。
统计前应当去掉 <think>…</think> 块、以 > 开头的引用行和“助手：”“Assistant:”前缀。
当回复为空或只剩空白时，word_count 应当为 0。
decisions: 完成标准：去掉 think 块、引用行和前缀之后再计数；空回复计 0

diff:
diff --git a/export/count.py b/export/count.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/export/count.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+import re
+
+THINK = re.compile(r"<think>.*?</think>", re.S)
+PREFIX = re.compile(r"^(助手：|Assistant:)\s*", re.M)
+
+
+def word_count(reply: str) -> int:
+    text = THINK.sub("", reply)
+    text = "\n".join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not line.lstrip().startswith(">"))
+    text = PREFIX.sub("", text)
+    words = re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]|[A-Za-z0-9']+", text)
+    return len(words)
diff --git a/export/writer.py b/export/writer.py
--- a/export/writer.py
+++ b/export/writer.py
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@ def export_message(message):
     row = {"role": message.role, "text": message.text}
+    row["word_count"] = word_count(message.text) if message.role == "assistant" else None
     return row
